# PM SHRI KV Sulur Digital Library (DLMS)

Official Digital Library Management System for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Air Force Station Sulur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

## About
PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya AFS Sulur operates under Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Ministry of Education, Government of India. The Digital Library (DLMS) provides students, teachers, and staff with access to thousands of books, digital reference materials, reading analytics, gamified book quizzes, and catalog search.

- Website: https://dlms.kvsulur.in/
- Institution: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya AFS Sulur
- Location: Air Force Station Sulur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu - 641401, India
- Phone: +91 422 2682215
- Contact: dlms@kvsulur.in

## Public Pages & Services
- [Home Portal](https://dlms.kvsulur.in/): Central portal with announcements, book of the week, school reading statistics, and events.
- [Book Catalogue](https://dlms.kvsulur.in/catalog): Search physical library books, textbook copies, and fiction/non-fiction reference titles.
- [App Download](https://dlms.kvsulur.in/download): Download the Android APK and Windows desktop application.
- [Help & Support Desk](https://dlms.kvsulur.in/support): Student help desk for account recovery, library ID inquiries, and circulation questions.
- [Feedback](https://dlms.kvsulur.in/feedback): Suggest book acquisitions and website enhancements.

## Privacy Note
Student reading portfolios, individual issue records, and administrative dashboards require school authentication and are not public records.
